business_model.basis: Stated in the 10-K Business section (P1) and confirmed in the 10-Q MD&A (P4).

business_model.basis: Stated in the 10-Q MD&A (P4) with specific dollar and percentage breakdowns.
business_model.claim: Nurse and allied solutions segment revenue in Q2 2026 increased 11% to $422.0 million, driven by a 6% increase in average travelers on assignment, a $10.0 million increase in labor disruption revenue, and a 1% increase in average billable hours.
quotes: Nurse and allied solutions segment revenue increased 11% to $422.0 million for the three months ended June 30, 2026 from $381.9 million for the same period in 2025.

The $40.1 million increase was primarily attributable to a $20.3 million increase driven by a 6% increase in the average number of travelers on assignment, a $10.0 million increase in labor disruption revenue related to reserve releases and billing true ups from multiple large scale labor disruption events that we supported in the prior periods, an $8.6 million increase driven by non-volume revenue, and a $3.3 million increase driven by a 1% increase in average billable hours.

business_model.basis: Stated in the 10-Q MD&A (P4) and the 10-K MD&A (P3).
business_model.claim: Labor disruption events (nurse and allied professional strikes) are a significant and recurring revenue driver, with the nurse and allied solutions segment including substantial labor disruption staffing revenue in Q1 2026.
quotes: The nurse and allied solutions segment included substantial labor disruption staffing revenue in the first quarter.
Even if somewhat recurrent over the long term, labor disruption events are unpredictable and have driven spikes in demand and related financial outcomes when they happen.

business_model.claim: In the physician and leadership solutions segment, locum tenens revenue is driven by days filled (volume) and revenue per day filled (pricing); in Q2 2026, locum tenens revenue declined 8% due to an 8% decrease in days filled.
quotes: Revenue in our locum tenens business declined $11.8 million (or 8%) due to a $12.1 million decline from an 8% decrease in the number of days filled.

business_model.claim: In the technology and workforce solutions segment, Q2 2026 revenue declined 15% to $86.7 million, with language services down 8% due to lower pricing, VMS down 20% due to lower staffing utilization and client losses, and the other technology business down 100% following the sale of Smart Square scheduling software.
quotes: Technology and workforce solutions segment revenue decreased 15% to $86.7 million for the three months ended June 30, 2026 from $101.8 million for the same period in 2025.

Revenue for our language services business declined $6.1 million (or 8%) primarily due to lower pricing, our other technology business declined $4.3 million (or 100%) due to the sale of our Smart Square scheduling software in the third quarter of 2025, and our VMS business declined $3.9 million (or 20%) due to lower staffing utilization on the platforms along with several client losses.
